chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: First onstage with Buck and Bubbles at Loew's State
summary: Green, about seventeen, is paid by Buck and Bubbles and first goes onstage with them at Loew's State, with Nazarro making everything legal.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: This was when you were living up in Harlem with Bubbles.
Yeah, I was there with the Sublets. His name was John W. Sublet, you see. He's --
Oh, I was going on about 17, I think, at the time.
And at this particular time you hadn't yet performed on stage as Chuck and Chuckles?
You were still in your training period?
Who was paying you at this time?
Well, Buck and Bubbles, you see. We
could go onstage with them, you see, in their act, you see, but we were still being trained, as you say.
Well, when was the first time you went onstage with them?
Well, the first time we went onstage with Buck and Bubbles was at the Loew's State, you see.
Well, I was going on 17, you see. But by them being adults and through the business mind of Nat Nazarra, I mean everything was legal. We'd have the proper permission, you see.
